The National Testing Agency (NTA) has issued a notification regarding the UGC NET/JRF December examination. According to the published details, the application window opened on October 8, 2026, and is scheduled to close on October 31, 2026.

Examination and Schedule Overview

Based on the reported details, the NTA UGC NET/JRF December examination is slated to be conducted on December 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, and 21, 2026.

  • Issuing Authority: National Testing Agency (NTA)
  • Notification ID / Exam: NTA UGC NET/JRF December 2026
  • Application Start Date: October 8, 2026
  • Application Last Date: October 31, 2026
  • Exam Dates: December 14 – 18 & 21, 2026

Eligibility and Qualifications

Reported criteria specify that candidates must have passed or be appearing in a Master's Degree examination in a relevant subject with a minimum aggregate of 55% marks from a recognized university or institution. Age relaxation rules apply as per standard NTA regulations, though specific numerical age limits and fee structures were not detailed in the source text and remain Not specified.

Selection Stages and Practical Implications

  • Selection Stages: Written/Computer-Based Examination (exact tier details to be confirmed via official bulletin).
  • Admit Card & Answer Key Status: Not specified / Pending release prior to exam dates.
  • Vacancies: Not specified.

Applicants are advised to review the official notification thoroughly before completing their submissions.

How to Verify

To verify these announcements, review the official information bulletin, or access application portals, candidates should visit the official NTA UGC website at https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in/ or cross-reference notices hosted on authorized government domains.
